profile.headline: Software Engineering Professional with Expertise In Delivering High Quality Software
profile.jobTitle: Experienced Software Engineer with proven track record of delivering high quality software
profile.summary:
I am an accomplished software engineer with 10+ years of experiences in the telecommunication industry. Some of my qualifications are listed below:

- Understand multiple telecom technologies (CDMA, EVDO, and LTE). 
- Experienced with various industry processes such as Digital/SixSigma and CMMI to deliver software on time with high quality. Experienced with various software engineering methodologies such as waterfall, iterative, and agile/scrum. 
- Experienced with OOA/OOD with UML utilizing design patterns using software such as Rhapsody and Tau. 
- Experienced with multithreaded, networking(client/server/TCP/UDP) applications. 
- Experienced with Linux IPC (shared memory, message queues, semaphores, signals, and pthreads.) 
- Developed applications using C/C++ for RTOS such as VxWorks and MontaVista Linux. 
- Familiar with STL and boost libraries. 
- Familiar with various programming/scripting languages (c/c++/java, bash, tcsh, TCL/Expect, perl, and python.) 
- Familiar with various static analysis tools (PClint, Klocwork, and CodeSonar.) Familiar with various unit test tools (Cantata++, Rational RT.) 
- Familiar with various source control tools (sablime, ClearCase/Quest, cvs, subversion, and git) 

I am an excellent team player. I have worked in team large or small. I have work with local as well as international teams. I have worked with people across multiple functional areas from requirement to test. I was part of the Motorola team that delivered the first commercial CDMA IS95A/B system to Japan's KDDI. I was part of the team that have achieved the SEI level 4 software development process.

positions.title: Experienced Software Engineer with proven track record of delivering high quality software
positions.description: Experienced Software Engineer with proven track record of delivering high quality software seeking opportunities where my background of Object-Oriented C++/Java development using UML with design patterns and Agile/Scrum methodologies will make the greatest difference.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the new Vector trading platform team
Responsible for the Firm Interface Gateway and the Clearing System Interface functionalities

Agile/TDD Java development using GIT for SCM, Maven for build and JUnit for UT with CI using Bamboo/Jenkin

Firm Interface Gateway
- logging in valid users and sending them instrument and order data.
- multithreaded concurrent design to allow simultaneous user access, leveraging executor, concurrent hashmap, and array blocking queue.
- direct hazelcast client for realtime data update and retrival.
- perform sql query via OracleDataSource connection for user order retrival.

Clearing System Interface
- convert internal trade message to FIXML format and send to OCC via IBM MQ for trade clearing.
- Non-blocking TCP server using selector to receive trade message from internal clients.
- perform message validation and FIXML format compliance verification to ensure no OCC rejection.
- perform duplicate message filtering to ensure unique message delivery to OCC.
- participated in OCC compliance testing.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Framework(middleware libraries) Team.

C++ development using STL and Boost libraries on SDG OS(custom Linux OS)
- fixes defects, stop memory leaks, and refactor existing code.
- refactor the on-screen button panel code to utilize the modern video server while maintain compatibility with legacy game types.
- investigated on the effort to refactor the existing mechanical button panel code to make it more user friendly and less error prone.

positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Nokia Siemens Networks, LTE Small Cell Product Team.
Responsible for the SON (Self Organizing Network) functionality.

Embedded C++ development under VxWorks Linux(RTOS) running on Motorola LTE BCU3 hardware
- convert L2/L3 messages between NSN Flexi C_Plane UEC application and the SCP AP DAN3400 modem
- adopt Motorola Macro LTE SON functionality (CSON w/ 3 cells) for use on the small cell implementation (DSON w/ 12 pico cells)
- Update PCI selection algorithm to support 12 pico cells
- Update Tomcat Google Maps visualization tool to support the small cell platform.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Motorola Networks CDMA Division Call Processing Team.

Embedded C/C++ application development on MontaVista Linux, VxWorks, and Vertex OS(RTOS)
- implemented various CDMA callprocessing applications. (IS95A/B, 1x/2000, and EVDO)
- OOA/OOD (w/ design patterns) using UML w/ Rhapsody (auto code generation) and Tau G2 IDEs.
- L2/L3 message conversion. Authoring interface documents.
- Full SDLC using Waterfall, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.
- Linux IPC development utilizing signals, shared memory, sockets, semaphore, and pthreads.
- Convert handwritten C++ application into UML model based application with auto code generation using Rhapsody IDE.
- Maintain Network Element Manager software. Network Manager Element is a Java J2EE server application with a MySQL database keeping track of all the network elements its managing. 
- Resolve semaphores deadlock issue due to nested callbacks.
- Replace OpenSource DES library
- Update Freescale uboot bootloader to work with new hardware Freescale P4080 processor.
- Perform Unite Test(Cantata++/Rational RT), Component Test(Rational RT), and Regression Test on software components.
- Support System Integration effort and Field/Customer found defects.
- Participated in code inspections and use static analyses tools(Klocworks) to prevent fault injection.
- Utilize Clearcase/Clearquest for source control, defect tracking, and code inspections.
- Automate simple tasks with scripts using various languages such as csh/tcsh/bash, Perl, Python, and Expect/TCL.
